spans.s:
नैपाल, अस्, ई, अम्, produced &c. in Nepal;
(अस्), m. a species of sugar-cane; the Nepal Nimba,
a species of tree; (ई), f. red arsenic; a species of
plant, Arabian jasmine, Jasminum Zambac and Nyc-
tanthes Arbor Tristis; the indigo plant.
नैपाल नैपाल. See under नेपाल, p. 516.

नैपालिक, अस्, ई, अम्, produced in or brought
from Nepal; (अम्), n. copper.

नैपालीय, अस्, ई, अम्, produced in or brought
from Nepal.
—नैपालीय-देवता-कल्याण-पञ्च-
विंशतिका, f., N. of a Buddhist work.

नैप नैप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नीप), belonging
or relating &c. to the Nauclea Cadamba.

नैपातिक नैपातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-पात),
only mentioned incidentally or by the way.

नैपातिथ नैपातिथ, अम्, n. (fr. नीपातिथि),
N. of a Sāman.

नैपुण नैपुण or नैपुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. नि-
पुण), dexterity, cleverness, skill; artfulness; expe-
rience, exactness, strictness; anything which requires
skill, a delicate matter; totality, completeness, com-
pletion.
